professionalSummary: Deployed cluster changes to three production message queue clusters, including two broker version upgrades and a tiered storage move, each documented in a change record in my name. (src_ef2cb34b2b82)

Operated on the platform on-call rota, handling production incidents such as a partition leader storm in July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log. (src_a064e8db56dd)

Monitored live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and coordinated capacity changes with owners of the six busiest topics, recording responsibilities in each change record. (src_f6ac277ea545)
Tested each cluster change on staging clusters using a documented load profile before production deployment, attaching staging results to the change record. (src_f0a6c46c18ef)
Documented cluster limitations and hand‑over conditions for each change in the change record’s closure section and in the platform runbook. (src_ed2e665b529e)
experienceHighlights: Deployed cluster changes to three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name. (src_ef2cb34b2b82)

On the platform on‑call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log. (src_a064e8db56dd)

Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners’. (src_f6ac277ea545)
Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record. (src_f0a6c46c18ef)
Documented cluster limitations and the hand‑over conditions for each change in the change record’s closure section and in the platform runbook. (src_ed2e665b529e)
